title: [review] messaging.py:145: Sent messages use module const
description: Sent message trimming uses `_MESSAGES_MAX` (module constant 100) instead of `self._max_messages` (instance parameter). Contrast with inbox trimming at line 86 which correctly uses `self._max_messages`. If MessagesResource(max_messages=10) is constructed, inbox caps at 10 but sent caps at 100, violating caller expectations.
